channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A reação de Flávio Bolsonaro após Michelle expor desavença
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said nothing could bother him on a day of Brazil’s World Cup match, hours after Michelle Bolsonaro exposed family tensions in a video, accusing him of disrespect and trying to sideline her from party decisions. She said she was treated like an idiot and withdrew after a harsh phone call. Flávio kept a light tone, focusing on football and avoiding direct comment on the conflict.

item.title: Aliados veem vídeo de Michelle como exposição desnecessária de divergências com Flávio e temem prejuízo à campanha
item.description: Allies of pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro expressed concern over a video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticizing him publicly, fearing the family conflict’s exposure could damage his appeal among female voters, particularly evangelicals and PL Women’s leaders. While party leadership downplays the crisis, saying the party is bigger than individuals, allies like Deputy Zé Trovão called the dispute immature and harmful, distracting from the opposition’s focus during economic and security challenges.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro acusa Flávio de desrespeito e expõe racha familiar
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespect and humiliation during a phone call, exposing a rift within the Bolsonaro family. She shared the account in a video posted on social media, stating she was treated inadequately by the brother of former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: "Ninguém me aborrece", diz Flávio Bolsonaro após vídeo de Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided commenting on a video in which Michelle Bolsonaro claims he disrespected and humiliated her during a phone call. In a YouTube live stream, he focused on Brazil's World Cup match against Scotland, stating that 'nothing and nobody' would bother him that day. Michelle accused the senator of treating her poorly, questioning her political understanding, and suggesting she stay out of party decisions.

item.title: “É dia de jogo, nada nem ninguém me aborrece”, diz Flávio após vídeo de Michelle
item.description: Senator and presidential pré-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reacted to a video posted by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she accused him of disrespect during an internal political disagreement. He responded that, being 'game day', nothing or nobody bothers him and that he prefers to focus on positive matters. The public exchange highlights growing tensions within the Bolsonarist circle.

item.title: Flávio evita falar de Michelle e diz que nada tira seu bom humor
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro avoided commenting on Michelle Bolsonaro's accusations, stating that his good mood would not be affected by the Brazilian national team playing in the World Cup. Michelle posted Instagram videos claiming she was 'stabbed in the back' and humiliated by Flávio after criticizing the PL's support for Ciro Gomes in a Ceará event. Flávio said what is at stake in Brazil is above any vanity and redirected focus to football.

item.title: Michelle joga um Dark Horse em Flávio Bolsonaro ao dizer que foi apunhalada
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he disrespected and mistreated her, and suggested his pre-candidacy should be 'sent to the electoral hospital', using a metaphor to imply it is weak or nonviable. The remark was delivered calmly but carried significant weight in the family's political dynamics.

item.title: Haddad: definição de vice na chapa em SP será feita até quinta (25)
item.description: Fernando Haddad announced that the decision on his running mate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race will be made by Thursday (June 25). He stated the choice is his responsibility following a meeting with Lula and Márcio França, during which Marina Silva, Simone Tebet, and França themselves offered to run for vice-governor or senator. While the PT prefers França as vice, he has expressed interest in a Senate run, and PSB allies view his gubernatorial bid as a strategic test rather than a viable option.

item.title: Michelle diz que Flávio Bolsonaro a desrespeitou em novo abalo na campanha do senador
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespecting her in a phone call after they disagreed on the PL's electoral strategy. She claims he does not want her support for his 2026 presidential bid, creating a new rift within the family and party alliance.

item.title: Caso Master: Jaques Wagner anuncia afastamento de cargo após operação da PF
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) officially announced his withdrawal from the government leadership in the Senate, following a private meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the Palácio do Planalto. The decision came shortly after developments in Operation Compliance Zero, a Federal Police investigation into alleged irregularities in public contracts. The move aims to safeguard government stability amid mounting political and judicial pressures.

item.title: Após críticas de Michelle, Flávio faz live, mas não a cita diretamente: ‘Hoje, nada me aborrece’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a YouTube live shortly after his stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro released videos criticizing him, though he did not mention her directly, instead framing the stream as a casual pre-match chat ahead of Brazil's game. He emphasized the presence of his wife, Fernanda Bolsonaro, to appeal to female voters ahead of the 2026 elections, and noted a recent meeting with former President Jair Bolsonaro, whom he described as steadfast and guiding his political mission.

item.title: Entenda o conflito no PL do Ceará que levou ao rompimento entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Flávio Bolsonaro of mistreatment and disrespect in a phone call following their disagreement over a potential alliance between the PL and Ciro Gomes in Ceará. While Flávio supports Alcides Fernandes for the Senate, Michelle backs Priscila Costa, national vice-president of PL Women, citing her key role in André Fernandes’ Fortaleza mayoral campaign. The rift highlights a deeper split in Bolsonarist circles in Ceará, with the party’s senatorial candidacy to be decided by the end of the July party convention.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle interrompe tentativa de trégua com Flávio, dizem aliados
item.description: A video of former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she attacks presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, disrupted an ongoing truce between the two that had been brokered by allies within the PL. The rupture exposes internal party tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após vídeo de Michelle, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que 'ninguém' o aborrece em dia de jogo do Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said nothing or nobody bothers him on a day when Brazil plays in the World Cup, following a video by Michelle Bolsonaro criticating her sons. He announced weekly live streams like his father and confirmed attendance at a conservative event in Argentina. Eduardo Bolsonaro has not yet commented on Michelle's video but posted a photo watching Brazil vs. Scotland.

item.title: Criticado por Michelle, Flávio diz que é dia de jogo e que ninguém o aborrecerá
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro downplayed criticisms from Michelle Bolsonaro, stating he would not be bothered by her as it was match day for Brazil in the World Cup. He avoided controversy, emphasized focusing on positive topics like football, and mentioned visiting his father Jair Bolsonaro, who sent greetings to everyone.

item.title: Michelle diz ter sido “humilhada” por Flávio e que não o procura mais
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro claims she was 'stabbed in the back' and humiliated by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after publicly criticizing the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará in 2025. She says Flávio rebuked her over the phone, telling her she didn’t understand politics and should stay out of party decisions, and that they have not spoken since — despite him visiting her home weekly.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que foi humilhada por Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Uma punhalada’; veja vídeo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro revealed she was humiliated by Flávio Bolsonaro in a phone call, describing it as 'a stab in the back,' after he told her to stay out of party decisions and said she didn’t understand politics. The conflict escalated after Michelle publicly criticized the PL Ceará’s alliance with Ciro Gomes, which Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro viewed as disrespectful to former President Jair Bolsonaro. Michelle reaffirmed her opposition to the alliance, citing Ciro’s offensive remarks about the Bolsonaro family and asserting he cannot be trusted by the right.

item.title: Fachin pede análise antes de decidir relatoria de caso “Dark Horse”
item.description: Supreme Court President Justice Edson Fachin requested a technical analysis from the Judiciary Secretariat before assigning a rapporteur to the investigation request linked to the film 'Dark Horse', which alleges irregularities in the financing involving Jair Bolsonaro, his sons, and Banco Master. The rapporteurship is contested between Justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, with the PGR supporting a decision based on formal connections to other investigations. After the analysis, Fachin will decide whether to keep the case with Moraes, transfer it to Mendonça, or assign it by lot among the justices.

item.title: Em resposta a Flávio, Itamaraty diz que ‘traidores da pátria’ devem desculpas pelo tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Brazilian Foreign Ministry rebutted Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s criticism, stating that the government has actively engaged in the U.S. trade dispute through direct governmental channels, including written defenses and high-level meetings in Washington. It claimed that 'traitors of the Fatherland' should apologize for the U.S. tariffs, linking them to an alleged external interference in Brazil’s justice system. Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, accused the government of inaction and announced his intention to testify at the USTR public hearing in July.

item.title: Crusoé: “Traidores da Pátria não conseguirão reescrever a história”, diz Itamaraty
item.description: The Itamaraty reacted to the possible participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a USTR public hearing on proposed 25% tariffs on Brazilian imports, stating that 'traitors of the homeland will not be able to rewrite history'. The statement was issued in response to bolsonarist support for the senator’s initiative to influence U.S. trade policy against Brazil.

item.title: Michelle abre guerra nas redes contra Flávio Bolsonaro e tenta influenciar decisão do PL no Ceará: 'Me tratam como idiota'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro publicly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in Instagram videos, accusing him of mistreating her and dismissing her political support as insignificant during a 2023 family rift over Ceará elections. She stated her actions were always agreed upon with Jair Bolsonaro and described the brothers' criticism as coordinated and aggressive. Michelle sought to influence the PL's decision in Ceará, opposing support for Ciro Gomes.

item.title: ‘Traidores da Pátria’: Itamaraty reage ao pedido de Flávio de participar de reunião nos EUA sobre tarifas
item.description: Brazil's Ministry of Foreign Affairs harshly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for requesting to participate in a U.S. public hearing on tariffs imposed on Brazilian goods, labeling him and others supporting the measure as 'traitors of the Fatherland'. The Itamaraty stated that such hearings are for private sector and civil society, not foreign government representatives, and demanded an 'apology for the tariffs and the damages caused'. Bolsonaro had said he would oppose the proposed U.S. tariff and advocate for a negotiated solution.

item.title: Itamaraty critica Flávio ir aos EUA tratar de tarifaço: 'Traidor da pátria'
item.description: The Itamaraty (Brazilian Ministry of Foreign Affairs) criticized the possible participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a U.S. public hearing on American tariffs against Brazilian products, without naming him directly, stating such action would harm national interests. The ministry's statement was seen as a diplomatic rebuke of the senator’s initiative, which aligns with opposition efforts to challenge Brazil’s foreign trade policy. The incident underscores tensions between the executive branch and opposition figures over the management of international trade relations.

item.title: 'Hoje é dia de jogo, nada nem ninguém me aborrece', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após ser alvo de Michelle em vídeo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said 'today is game day, nothing or nobody bothers me' during a YouTube live, following an Instagram video by Michelle Bolsonaro that mentioned him. He avoided commenting on the incident, focusing on football and mentioning a visit to former president Jair Bolsonaro, from whom he said he received a hug for everyone. He appeared alongside his wife wearing a Neymar mask.

item.title: 'Ele foi muito ríspido', 'me maltratou no telefone': veja FRASES do vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro of publicly attacking her on social media after an event in Ceará, describing his conduct as a 'stab in the back' and saying he was rude and disrespectful in a subsequent phone call. She claimed the attacks were coordinated with his brothers and that she had tried to contact him privately before the public posts, without success.

item.title: Jaques Wagner deixa liderança do governo no Senado após operação da PF
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) announced he will step down as government leader in the Federal Senate following a meeting with President Lula, prompted by the fallout from a recent Federal Police operation investigating alleged financial benefits tied to Banco Master. The resignation, mutually agreed upon, aims to shield the government’s public image ahead of the 2026 elections while allowing Wagner to focus on proving his innocence and supporting Lula’s, Jerônimo Rodrigues’s, and his own re-election bids. Senators Camilo Santana (PT-CE) and Teresa Leitão (PT-PE) are being considered as potential replacements.

item.title: Após Flávio pedir para participar de audiência sobre tarifas dos EUA contra Brasil, Itamaraty diz que 'traidores da pátria' devem pedido de desculpa
item.description: The Itamaraty accused 'traitors of the homeland' of owing an apology for U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, linking them to alleged foreign interference in Brazil’s judiciary. The Brazilian government says it has pursued a negotiated solution since June 2025, submitting written defenses and holding high-level talks in Washington, with a deadline for agreement by July 15. Flávio Bolsonaro requested to participate in the USTR’s July 6 public hearing on Trump’s proposed tariffs.

item.title: ‘Humilhação’: Michelle sobe o tom e expõe desavença com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro released a video accusing her brother-in-law, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, of humiliating her during a phone call after she tried to discuss the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará. She claims Flávio was rude, disrespected her, and suggested she stay out of party decisions. Michelle also denounced the alliance with Ciro Gomes, blaming him for Jair Bolsonaro’s 2023 ineligibility and rejecting the insults he allegedly made against her family.

item.title: STF mantém ônus da prova com acusação e sujeita partidos à Lei de Improbidade
item.description: The STF voted to amend the Administrative Improbity Law, ruling that political parties are also subject to the law and rejecting the reversal of the burden of proof against defendants. It also invalidated the rule allowing the suspension of political rights to be counted from the collegial decision until final judgment, stating that political rights are treated differently from ineligibility under the Constitution.

item.title: “Ele me desrespeitou”, diz Michelle sobre ligação de Flávio
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro publicly criticized her brother-in-law, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, for disrespecting her during a phone call, saying she was treated 'like an idiot'. She released 27 minutes of videos on her social media, highlighting the poor treatment she received.

item.title: ANÁLISE: Michelle risca o chão, se apresenta como a Bolsonaro mais leal a Jair e detona Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro released a video accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating and disrespecting her, claiming he told her she didn’t understand politics and that her presence wasn’t needed in the PL’s pre-campaign. She positions herself as the most loyal to Jair Bolsonaro, contrasting her stance with his sons, who allegedly pursued alliances with opponents like Ciro Gomes. The video exposes an internal rift in Bolsonarism, reinforcing her image as a victim and faithful follower, while associating Flávio with family-related damage.

item.title: Presidente da Coreia do Sul fará visita oficial ao Brasil
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae-kyung will make an official visit to Brazil from July 26 to 28, meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Brasília to strengthen bilateral partnerships in technology, energy transition, and semiconductors. After engagements in Brasília, he will travel to São Paulo to deepen ties with South Korean corporations and the local Korean community, before proceeding to Santiago, Chile, as part of a strategic tour of South America amid global supply chain realignments.

item.title: TSE recebe inspeção de códigos-fonte das urnas para as eleições
item.description: The TSE received the SBC for inspection of the source code of the electronic voting machines for the 2026 elections, a process that began in October 2025 and will continue until September 2026. The analysis covers voting, transmission, tallying, and encryption systems to ensure transparency and integrity of the vote. The digital signature and sealing ceremony will take place in September, ahead of the first round on October 4.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro posta vídeo e diz ter sido 'apunhalada' e humilhada por Flávio: 'Entendi que não queria meu apoio'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating and 'stabbing her in the back' during a phone call, claiming he disrespected her and told her to stay out of party decisions following a dispute over the PL's alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará. She said they have not spoken since the end of 2025. Flávio responded with a live stream downplaying the conflict, saying he was focused on the Brazil match and reaffirming his support for Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Michelle sobre Flávio: “Ele me desrespeitou e me maltratou ao telefone” — veja vídeo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespect and mistreatment during a phone call, claiming he treated her as if she were ignorant and discouraged her from participating in party decisions. She also criticized her other stepson, Eduardo Bolsonaro, for leading a U.S.-based far-right group that attacks her and tries to erase her Bolsonaro surname. Since the phone incident, she and Flávio have not spoken, and she has chosen to withdraw from supporting Jair Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign to honor his stated boundaries.

item.title: Como está a avaliação do governo Lula a quase 3 meses da eleição, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp Institute poll conducted from June 15–18, 2026 shows President Lula’s government with 43% approval, 50% disapproval, and 7% undecided, with a margin of error of 2.19 percentage points. Approval has risen since surveys on June 5 and 12, and is highest among women (50%) and in the North (54%) and Northeast (53%) regions. The findings are relevant for shaping Lula’s campaign strategy as he seeks a fourth term in the October 2026 elections.

item.title: Após Lula criticar Neymar, Flávio publica vídeo por IA para ‘resgatar menino Ney’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released an AI-generated video in which he travels to the United States to persuade Neymar to return to the Brazilian national team, following criticism from President Lula. The video blends military symbolism, Top Gun nostalgia, and emotional appeal to reinforce the narrative that Brazil never abandons its heroes, released just hours before Brazil’s match against Scotland in the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Tarcísio volta a rebater Haddad sobre Sabesp: "Precisa estudar mais"
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas rebutted Fernando Haddad's criticism of the Sabesp privatization, stating that Haddad needs to 'study more to avoid embarrassment'. He defended the 2024 reduction of state ownership from 50.3% to 18%, which allowed Equatorial and market investors to acquire stakes, while Haddad alleged the sale lacked transparency and was conducted 'among friends' without competitive bidding.

item.title: Michelle acusa "grupo coordenado no exterior" de atacá-la todos os dias
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro claims she is the target of daily coordinated attacks by a group based abroad, which attempts to defame her by removing her Bolsonaro surname in social media posts and videos. She states she does not support Ciro Gomes’ candidacy for governor of Ceará, despite some right-wing leaders backing him, and defends her political experience through her work with PL Women. Michelle also says she has forgiven and learned to cope with criticisms from her stepchildren, including Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: A disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno, em nova pesquisa
item.description: A June 2026 Gerp poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) 42% to 40% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, within the 2.19-point margin of error — a technical tie. The survey of 2,000 voters conducted June 15–20, registered as BR-09657/2026 with the TSE, also shows Lula in technical ties with Romeu Zema (Novo) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) in other scenarios.

item.title: Jaques Wagner anuncia saída da liderança do governo no Senado
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) announced he will step down as the government leader in the Senate, nearly a week after being targeted by a Federal Police operation over alleged involvement with Banco Master. He informed President Lula in a meeting at the Palácio do Alvorada, stating his priority is to prove his innocence and focus on the re-election campaigns of Lula, Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, and his own Senate re-election bid alongside Rui Costa.

item.title: Michelle critica Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que foi maltratada: 'Entendi que não queria meu apoio'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, of disrespect and mistreatment after he allegedly indicated he did not want her support for his presidential pre-candidacy. She also criticized the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes for the Ceará governorship and mentioned attacks from her stepsons over her support for Senator Eduardo Girão.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro "resgata" Neymar em vídeo de IA com alfinetada a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shared an AI-generated video depicting himself 'rescuing' Neymar for the 2026 World Cup, responding to Lula's joke that the player would be the 'first home office call-up in history'. The deepfake-style video shows the senator piloting a Brazilian Air Force aircraft to retrieve Neymar, framing it as a patriotic mission to protect national heroes. Posted hours before Brazil's match against Scotland in Miami, the video renews concerns about AI use in political campaigns, which has been banned by the TSE since February 2024.

item.title: Após reunião com Lula, Jaques anuncia afastamento da liderança do governo no Senado
item.description: Senate government leader Jaques Wagner announced his resignation from the post following a meeting with President Lula, by mutual agreement, to focus on proving his innocence in the 9th phase of the Compliance Zero operation, a PF investigation into a billion-dollar financial fraud scheme involving Banco Master. He stated his priority is clearing his name and supporting the reelection of Lula, Jerônimo Rodrigues, and his own Senate re-election bid alongside Rui Costa.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula decide se mantém Wagner na liderança do governo no Senado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Senator Jaques Wagner to decide whether Wagner will remain as the government leader in the Senate, following Wagner being targeted in the ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police. The investigation examines alleged receipt of improper advantages to benefit private interests. The meeting was discussed on the Papo Antagonista program on Wednesday, the 24th.

item.title: Jaques Wagner deixa liderança do governo em "comum acordo" com Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) stepped down as Senate government leader in mutual agreement with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, following his targeting in Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police, which investigates alleged irregularities linked to Banco Master. Wagner stated his priority is now to prove his innocence and focus on Lula’s re-election, Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues’ re-election, and his own Senate re-election alongside Rui Costa. His exit was sought by government and PT allies to prevent the scandal from tarnishing Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Capacitação para candidatas das Eleições 2026 está com inscrições abertas
item.description: Registrations are now open for the 30th edition of the Electoral Candidates Course – Brazil Edition, an initiative by the OEA and Anadep with support from the TSE, offering in-person and virtual training for female candidates nationwide ahead of the 2026 General Elections. The program will be held in a hybrid format, with in-person sessions in Brasília on July 8–9 and a virtual session on July 17, providing 480 spots for the virtual track and up to 100 for the in-person track. The opening ceremony will be streamed publicly via the TSE’s YouTube channel and TV Justiça, while all other activities will be reserved exclusively for selected participants.

item.title: Michelle diz que Flávio Bolsonaro a desrespeitou e humilhou em ligação
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespect and humiliation in a phone call after she opposed the PL's articulation in Ceará to form an alliance with Ciro Gomes. She said he spoke rudely, questioned her political experience, and suggested she stay out of party decisions. Michelle argues that Bolsonaro supporters should back Eduardo Girão for governor of Ceará, calling an alliance with Ciro Gomes incoherent given his past criticism of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Jaques Wagner deixa Palácio da Alvorada após reunião com Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) left the Palácio da Alvorada after meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) on Wednesday, the 24th, at 4:40 PM. The meeting lasted approximately two hours.

item.title: Flávio, CNI e Klabin: saiba quem quer falar em audiência do tarifaço
item.description: The USTR public hearing on Brazil’s trade practices received 85 participation requests, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and representatives from CNI, Klabin, and Bauducco. The Lula government will not send representatives, while CNI advocates direct negotiation to avoid tariffs that could disrupt supply chains. Companies argue there is no trade imbalance justifying new tariffs and that such measures would raise costs for U.S. importers and harm domestic industries.
